text:
one of Lorca's best lines

is,

"agony, always

agony..."

think of this when

you kill a

cockroach or

pick up a blade to

shave

waking in the morning

to

face the

sun

translation.title: One of Lorca's Best Lines...
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps Bukowski's lowercase plainness and the Lorca line as a blunt morning refrain.
